dialogues.speaker: Scions of the Canopy General Message Board
dialogues.text: "At Chief Wayna's suggestion, this community bulletin board has been repurposed to serve as a general message board. Aside from being a place to display important news concerning the tribe, feel free to leave any other messages here too."

dialogues.speaker: Scions of the Canopy General Message Board
dialogues.text: "Both members of the Scions of the Canopy and visitors from outside the tribe are welcome to share feedback and requests at any time!"
